mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months reduces the discount rate applied to future cash flows, increasing the present value of equity prices and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5% for 3 consecutive months signals tightening monetary policy, raising discount rates and compressing equity valuations, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) exceeding 2% month-over-month for 3 consecutive months indicates weakening labor demand, lowering consumer confidence and compressing equity valuations, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in weak-demand periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) below 1.5% month-over-month for 3 consecutive months signals strengthening labor demand, boosting consumer confidence and equity valuations, which predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in strong-demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 2% for 3 consecutive months indicates expanding supply capacity, lowering marginal costs and compressing equity valuations, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below -1% for 3 consecutive months signals contracting supply capacity, raising marginal costs and compressing equity valuations, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in home sales (HOUST) above 1.5% for 3 consecutive months indicates strengthening demand, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in strong-demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in home sales (HOUST) above -2% for 3 consecutive months signals weakening demand, compressing equity valuations and predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in weak-demand periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
